text: Given a request to any tool without the X-Notion-Api-Key header, When the server handles it, Then it returns HTTP 401 listing the missing header
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_middleware.py::test_missing_header_returns_401 -v -> 3 passed (3 header variants: absent, empty, unresolved placeholder). Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a valid API key, When notion_search is called with a text query, Then it returns matching pages/databases with id, object, title, url, last_edited_time
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_search_returns_matches -v -> 1 passed. Asserts the collapsed shape {id, object, title, url, last_edited_time} against a mocked POST /v1/search response. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a result set larger than limit, When notion_search is called with a small limit, Then has_more is true and next_cursor is usable to continue
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_search_paginates -v -> 1 passed. Asserts page_size sent to Notion equals limit, and has_more/next_cursor are passed through from the mocked response. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given an accessible page id, When notion_get_page is called, Then it returns id, parent, archived flag, url, and flattened properties
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_get_page_returns_full_shape -v -> 1 passed. Asserts {id, parent:{type,id}, archived, url, properties} with properties flattened (title -> plain string, select -> option name). Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a non-existent or unshared page id, When notion_get_page is called, Then it returns code: not_found
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_get_page_not_found_returns_not_found_code -v -> 1 passed. Mocks Notion's 404 object_not_found body and asserts the envelope code is not_found. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a parent database id and valid properties, When notion_create_page is called, Then a new page is created and its id and url are returned
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_create_page_under_database_succeeds -v -> 1 passed. Asserts the tool fetches the database schema first, maps {Name: str, Status: str} to Notion's typed title/select property JSON, and returns {id, url}. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a property value of the wrong type for the target database schema, When notion_create_page is called, Then it returns code: invalid_argument
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_create_page_invalid_property_type_returns_invalid_argument -v -> 1 passed. A property name not present in the database's schema is rejected locally (invalid_argument, naming the field) before any write call is made -- also asserts no POST /v1/pages request was sent. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given an existing page, When notion_update_page sets archived true then archived false, Then the page is trashed then restored (round-trips, not permanently lost)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_update_page_archive_and_restore_roundtrip -v -> 1 passed. Calls archived:true then archived:false against a mocked PATCH /v1/pages/{id} and asserts both round-trip. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a database id, When notion_get_database is called, Then it returns the property schema (name, type, type-specific config)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_get_database_returns_schema -v -> 1 passed. Asserts {id, title, url, properties} with a select property's options list included. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a database id with and without a filter, When notion_query_database is called, Then it returns all pages (no filter) or only matching pages (with filter), paginated
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_query_database_filter_and_no_filter -v -> 1 passed. Asserts the request body omits 'filter' when none is given, and passes it through verbatim when given. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a page/block id with mixed child block types, When notion_list_block_children is called, Then each child's type and plain text are returned, paginated if many
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_list_block_children_paginates -v -> 1 passed. Mixed paragraph + to_do blocks collapse to {id, type, text, has_children[, checked]}, has_more/next_cursor pass through. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a list of supported block types, When notion_append_block_children is called, Then the blocks are appended and their created ids are returned
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_append_block_children_supported_types -v -> 1 passed. Asserts the simplified {type, text} block is built into Notion's block JSON and the created block's id comes back. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a list containing one unsupported block type, When notion_append_block_children is called, Then it returns code: invalid_argument naming that type and nothing is appended
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_append_block_children_rejects_unsupported_type -v -> 1 passed. A 'table' block among otherwise-valid blocks is rejected before any request is sent (asserts zero recorded requests) -- 'table' is named in the error message. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a workspace, When notion_list_users is called, Then it returns users (id, name, person/bot type), paginated
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_list_users_returns_members -v -> 1 passed. Asserts both a person and a bot user collapse to {id, name, type}. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given Notion returns 429 with Retry-After, When any tool is called, Then the server retries honoring the delay, and returns code: rate_limited (never a raw 429/529) once retries are exhausted
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_rate_limit_retry_then_exhausted_returns_rate_limited tests/test_tools.py::test_rate_limit_retry_then_success -v -> 2 passed. Exhausted case: 4 attempts total (1 + 3 retries), final envelope is rate_limited/retryable:true, never a raw 429 body. Retry-then-success case confirms the server continues transparently after one 429. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a result set that would exceed the 20000-character response cap, When a list/query tool is called, Then the response is truncated with has_more/next_cursor set, never an unbounded payload
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_large_result_truncated_with_cursor -v -> 1 passed. 50 pages with a 3000-char title each (~150,000 raw chars) are shrunk to fit within 20,000 chars with has_more/fields_truncated set. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given two concurrent requests for two different tenants (two different X-Notion-Api-Key values) hitting the same container, When both are in flight at once, Then neither request's data or credential is visible to the other (security/multi-tenant isolation anchor)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_middleware.py::test_concurrent_requests_do_not_leak_context -v -> 1 passed. Two interleaved requests (asyncio.gather) with distinct keys each observe only their own key before and after an await point. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given the server is running, When tools/list is called, Then it returns exactly the 9 documented tools, each with a description <= 500 chars (first line <= 100), and the read tools carry readOnlyHint
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_tools_list_snapshot_nine_tools_with_hints -v -> 1 passed. Also independently confirmed live: started `python -m notion_mcp` and called tools/list over HTTP with a placeholder X-Notion-Api-Key header with no prior initialize (200, not 400 -- confirms stateless_http); response listed all 9 tool names. Full gate run: 39 passed, see Self-test section of docs/tickets/PRD-21313.md.

text: Given a real Notion internal integration token shared with one disposable test page and one test database, When the full create/get/update(archive+restore)/search/query/append/list-children path is run end to end, Then every step succeeds against the live API
steps: Obtain a real Notion internal integration token and share it with one disposable page and one disposable database
notion_create_page under the test database with a couple of properties
notion_get_page on the created page id, confirm properties match
notion_search for the page's title, confirm it is found
notion_query_database on the test database, confirm the created page is among the results
notion_append_block_children with a paragraph and a bulleted list item on the created page
notion_list_block_children on the created page, confirm the appended blocks are present
notion_update_page with archived: true, then again with archived: false, confirm restore
expect: Every step returns the shape documented in the Tech design 'Data & API contract' section; no step surfaces a raw Notion error instead of the mapped envelope
notes: needs a real vendor account (Notion internal integration token) -- does not block reaching 6b/6c per vendor-mcp-development SOP 'no test account is not a blocker'. A placeholder-credential live call was made instead (see TC-NTN-018 evidence): the server correctly reached the real Notion API and mapped its 401 (invalid token) to the unauthorized envelope end to end, which exercises the full HTTP/retry/error-mapping path without needing a real token.
